checks.title: Active index reconciles checked-in fork lane instances

actionItem.title: Make the active index derive from instance manifests
acceptance: Every active index entry must match the corresponding instance manifest.
CI must fail when the index diverges from any referenced instance.

checks.title: Fork-local regression and upstream proof planes are explicitly separated

actionItem.title: Split local fork regression from upstream remote proof policy
acceptance: Fork lane instances must declare fork-side remote proof disabled when self-hosted proof belongs upstream.
Upstream proof inputs must remain explicit in the instance manifest.

checks.title: Multiple owned forks carry explicit operational capability attributes

actionItem.title: Add explicit push and mount capability attributes to each owned fork
acceptance: Each owned fork entry declares whether it is eligible for local push operations.
Each owned fork entry declares whether it is eligible for upstream mount staging.
The selected fork can be evaluated from capabilities rather than free-text purpose alone.

checks.title: Lifecycle closure and supersession rules are conditionally enforced

actionItem.title: Add conditional lifecycle closure and supersession rules
acceptance: Closed instances require a close date.
Superseded instances require a replacement issue reference.
CI fails when lifecycle state and lifecycle evidence diverge.
